How to use this demo

Follow the instruction beside or above the phone and tap the matching control. The demo switches phones automatically when another traveller needs to act. Open Explore controls for optional paths or manual phone switching. Restart returns to the beginning. Fares, bookings, payments, and external services are simulated.
